title: Phase 4: RustFS native TLS (TLS-pattern canary)
description:
Enable native TLS on the RustFS host container via RUSTFS_TLS_PATH=/opt/tls with rustfs_cert.pem + rustfs_key.pem (owned by UID 10001 — same ACL pattern as dex-setup.sh). Cert from step-ca X5C with SANs for the in-cluster bridge name (objectstore-local.<ns>.svc.cluster.local) + host name + container kind-IP. Long-lived consumers (Mimir/Tempo S3 ca_file, CNPG Barman ObjectStore.spec.endpointCA) use full CA verification via trust-manager bundle. Ephemeral mc bucket-init pods use --insecure.

Proves the X5C → host-container TLS → trust-bundle loop on one store before adding a second (seaweedfs).

Covers item 3 from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: In-cluster CNPG-Barman + Mimir/Tempo verify the RustFS cert on full CA; backups stay green.

Loop type: host. No recreate.

title: Phase 7: Revocation exporter + monitoring
description:
Build a fully-custom Python host container (using cryptography for cert parsing + requests for CRL/OCSP) that probes each external endpoint's served cert for expiry and checks revocation against the step-ca CRL and Vault OCSP/CRL. Single coherent schema: cert_not_after_seconds, cert_revoked, crl_next_update_seconds. Bridge into the monitoring namespace via the selectorless Service + hand-written Endpoints → ${HOST_IP}:port pattern (cf. step-ca/traefik/service.yaml.tpl). Scrape via a ServiceMonitor. Surface in a Grafana panel + alert rules. Set CRL-freshness alert threshold relative to step-ca's renewPeriod (16h) / cacheDuration (24h) to avoid false alarms. Add host-side renew timer for external cert expiry auto-renew; revocation remediation stays human-triggered (reissue-<svc>.sh runbook).

Covers item 8b from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: step ca revoke on a throwaway cert flips cert_revoked; expiry metric present.

Loop type: host + in-cluster. No recreate.

title: Phase 6: ESO → Vault HTTPS
description:
Change the ClusterSecretStore server URL from http://vault.vault.svc…:8202 to https://vault.vault.svc…:8200 (the Vault cert already carries the vault.vault.svc.cluster.local SAN). Trust the CA via caProvider pointing to the trust-manager bundle (auto-rotates; showcases the feature). Extend the in-cluster vault bridge Service to also expose port 8200.

Small, isolated change — good filler between larger phases.

Covers item 5b from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: An ExternalSecret re-syncs over HTTPS via the trust-manager bundle.

Loop type: fast. No recreate.

title: Phase 9: Foundation recreate — encryption + Calico + apiserver-OIDC→Authelia
description:
THE ONE SLOW LOOP. Three items baked into k8s/kind-cluster.yaml.tpl force a full teardown → setup. Edit together to avoid clobbering: (1) secretbox encryption — EncryptionConfiguration with secretbox key, resources: [secrets] only; key generated by setup.sh before cluster create into gitignored k8s/encryption/secretbox.key (0600), mounted via kind extraMounts + apiserver extraVolumes + --encryption-provider-config kubeadm patch; teardown.sh deletes the key. (2) Calico CNI — set networking.disableDefaultCNI: true + podSubnet matching Calico IPPool; install tigera-operator Helm chart (version-pinned in common.sh) with Installation CR using VXLANCrossSubnet encapsulation. Calico deployed allow-all in this phase (NetworkPolicies deferred to Phase 10). (3) apiserver-OIDC→Authelia — rewrite oidc-issuer-url in template; rename mounted CA file to generic oidc-ca.pem. Sequencing: gen encryption key → kind create → Calico → MetalLB → rest of stack. Re-validate phases 1–8 on the new Calico/VXLAN datapath.

Steer point: Calico-on-WSL2 go/no-go — this is the riskiest unknown, isolated to one phase.

Covers items 2, 1a, and 6-rem from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: Cluster healthy on Calico/VXLAN, all pods Ready, MetalLB L2 still serves, etcdctl shows secretbox ciphertext, apiserver issuer points at Authelia (inert), and phases 1–8 re-validate on the target datapath.

Loop type: SLOW — full cluster recreate.

title: Phase 8: Authelia swap (host-side) + monitoring-Grafana HTTPS/OIDC
description:
Replace Dex with Authelia single host container. YAML config via envsubst (like dex-config.yaml.tpl), file users_database.yml with same users + groups (rbr-db-admin, rbr-ver-db-admin), SQLite storage, native TLS (step-ca cert), filesystem notifier, access_control.default_policy: one_factor. Repoint all 4 fast-loop OIDC consumers: Vault (oidc-setup.sh), self-service Grafana (grafana-rbr-ver), monitoring Grafana (grafana-monitoring), step-ca authelia provisioner. apiserver OIDC template edit is DEFERRED to Phase 9 (inert anyway). 5 OIDC clients: vault, step-ca, grafana-rbr-ver, grafana-monitoring (confidential, PBKDF2-hashed secrets in common.sh), kubernetes (public/PKCE, no secret). Password hashes reuse as-is (Authelia file provider accepts bcrypt). Vault user_claim: sub → email. Generate Authelia JWKS RSA keypair into gitignored authelia/secrets/. Replace dex-teardown.sh call with authelia-teardown.sh. Mirror dex/.gitignore pattern. Enable monitoring Grafana HTTPS (websecure IngressRoute + vault-pki Certificate + root_url: https) + auth.generic_oauth to Authelia. Keep local admin break-glass.

Steer point: the no-two-IdP-period constraint can be relaxed here since apiserver OIDC is inert — de-risk the swap if needed.

Covers items 6 and 7 from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: Vault, both Grafanas, and the step-ca authelia provisioner all auth via Authelia; Dex container/scripts gone; local admin break-glass still works.

Loop type: host + in-cluster. No recreate (* apiserver template edit deferred to Phase 9).

title: Phase 3: step-ca CDP + Vault-PKI revocation config
description:
Add crlDistributionPoints = URI:https://${STEP_CA_HOST}:${STEP_CA_PORT}/1.0/crl to step-ca leaf cert templates on the issuing provisioner(s), where STEP_CA_HOST = step-ca.${HOST_IP_DASHED}.sslip.io. Configure Vault PKI OCSP and CRL (belt-and-suspenders). Forces reissue of all existing external certs — accepted blast radius.

Must be sequenced before Phases 4–5 so new external certs are born with the CDP, avoiding a double reissue.

Steer point: confirm CDP reissue blast radius is acceptable before proceeding.

Covers item 8a (split) from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: A freshly-issued leaf carries the CDP extension; curl …:8443/1.0/crl returns a CRL.

Loop type: host/config. No recreate.

title: Phase 5: seaweedfs host container + Loki repoint
description:
Stand up one chrislusf/seaweedfs server -s3 host container (mini all-in-one) with S3 gateway on :8333 over TLS (step-ca cert via security.toml [https.s3]), bridged into the grafana namespace. Write an S3 identities JSON with a dedicated bucket-scoped loki identity (Read/Write/List/Tagging on loki bucket only). Add SEAWEEDFS_* / LOKI_S3_* vars to common.sh. Repoint monitoring/loki/loki-values.yaml S3 endpoint from http://objectstore-local…:9000 → https://seaweedfs.grafana.svc…:8333 with real CA verification (AWS_CA_BUNDLE/ca_file via trust bundle). mc bucket-init for loki bucket uses --insecure. Add bare docker run --name to setup and guarded rm -f + volume cleanup to teardown.sh.

Steer point: confirm storage isolation actually held (old objectstore no longer takes Loki writes).

Covers items 4 and 5 from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: Logs land in the seaweedfs loki bucket; Grafana Loki queries work; old objectstore no longer takes Loki writes.

Loop type: host + in-cluster. No recreate.

title: Phase 2: Backup observability — alerts + panel
description:
Add Prometheus alert rules on the existing cnpg_collector_* series (last-available-backup age, last-failed-backup fired, recoverability-point gap). Add a Grafana backup panel. No new scrape target for Barman — no Barman metrics exist (verified against trunk manifest and chart).

Covers items 10a and 10b from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: Backup panel populates; a forced failed backup fires the _last_failed alert.

Loop type: fast. No recreate.
close_reason: Phase 2 complete: PrometheusRule (3 alerts), operator ServiceMonitor, GrafanaDashboard cnpg-backup (4 panels)

title: Phase 1: Platform refactor + demo PodMonitor dedupe
description:
Extract shared idempotent functions (install_cnpg_operator, install_barman_plugin) into common.sh. Move CNPG operator + Barman Cloud Plugin install from demo/setup.sh to scripts/setup.sh (platform/workload split). Remove redundant per-region demo/ PodMonitors and the demo/setup.sh:141-146 apply block — monitoring/setup.sh becomes the single owner of CNPG telemetry.

Covers items 9 and 10c from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: teardown→setup yields an identical green cluster (backups run, CNPG :9187 scrape intact). Also drills the rebuild loop and establishes baseline-green before any behavior change.

Loop type: rebuild-to-verify. No template change, no cluster recreate.
close_reason: Platform/workload split and PodMonitor dedupe complete. install_cnpg_operator + install_barman_plugin in common.sh, called from scripts/setup.sh. Per-region PodMonitor files deleted, monitoring/setup.sh is sole owner. Committed d76b87a.

title: Phase 10: NetworkPolicy allow-list + ingress default-deny flip
description:
Author the Calico NetworkPolicy allow-list and flip the GlobalNetworkPolicy ingress default-deny. Two starred rules are most likely to brick the flip and must be first-class: (★) kubelet→pod health probes — ingress from node host-CIDR to all workload pods on their probe ports (Grafana 3000, CNPG 9187, Loki 3100, …); without this pods flap NotReady after the flip. (★) MetalLB-L2→Traefik — external client → Traefik pod (websecure); source is real external client IP after L2, so must be a CIDR/nets-based ingress rule, not pod-selector. Additional allows: Traefik→Grafana :3000; Prometheus→CNPG :9187 + operator + kube-state-metrics + node-exporter; Alloy→Loki :3100; Grafana→Mimir/Tempo/Loki; cert-manager/ESO webhooks ↔ apiserver + metrics-server; always-allow DNS/kube-system/tigera/calico-system/metallb-system. Egress stays open (pedagogical choice). Observe allow-list working GREEN before flipping default-deny. Flip is fully reversible (delete the deny policy).

Steer point: do NOT flip until the allow-list is observed working.

Covers item 1b from the local hardening plan (docs/local-hardening-plan.md §E).

Test gate: Author the allow-list incl. the two ★ rules, observe green, then flip the GlobalNetworkPolicy ingress default-deny. Everything green under deny; one non-allowed flow confirmed blocked.

Loop type: fast (kubectl apply). No recreate.
